violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

( Various food product ) was observed held at (50-52 ) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC voluntarily disposed of product. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026
(Food product and beverages ) were observed stored on the floor in the (retail ). Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

(3 door refrigerator ) located in the (retail ) area was not in good repair. Ambient temperatures at 52DF. Establishment not allowed to store any TCS products in unit until repaired and/or replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026
Establishment is lacking 3 bay sink for wash, rinse, and sanitize for their equipment. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

The facility is lacking a mop sink. At least one mop sink or one curbed cleaning facility equipped with a floor drain must be provided and conveniently located for the cleaning of mops or similar wet floor cleaning tools and for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026
The (ceilings ) in the (retail) area is in poor repair. Observed holes The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026
The hand-washing sink in the coffee area was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/09/2024
The hand-washing sink in the coffee area was lacking signage. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 05/10/2024

Pollock fish was observed held at 48-51 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC voluntarily disposed of. New Violation. Correct By: 05/09/2024

The door to the outside, located in the entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 05/23/2024
Drinks were observed stored on the floor in the retail area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 05/09/2024
At the time of inspection, ambient of pepsi refrigerator was 48 degrees Fahrenheit. PIC took unit out of service. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/09/2024

Employees' personal belongings were observed stored in the retail freezer. Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of employees' clothing and other possessions. PIC informed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/09/2024
